records.part: Optic hardware and software lifecycle support, repair/maintenance, licenses, and additional optic system procurement for MADIS
records.reason: CACI is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the CM-262 optic systems modified and integrated into the Marine Air Defense Integrated System (MADIS) program. CACI holds the modification rights to the CM-262 source code and remains the only source available to provide the hardware and software lifecycle support.
records.installed_location: Hanahan, SC at the Naval Information Warfare Center
